description: B depends on A and overrides shared_calc, but A declares reads_shared after shared_calc and reads it as a prior result. B's override runs where B declares it, after all of A, so A's reader would have no value. The registry refuses the combination (owner decision on PR #267: refuse rather than evaluate a silent null, and no cross-module scheduling). Compare 04, where A's later calculation does not read shared_calc and the override loads. Listed before its dependency, B is refused by the existing dependency rule.
